topic.title: Tips and Tricks
topic.shortdesc: Discover lesser-known features and expert tips to enhance your smart home experience.

body.p: Use widgets on your smartphone for fast access to automation routines and frequently used devices.
Enable geo-fencing to trigger automations when you leave or return home.
Group multiple devices by room or function to streamline control and visibility.
Explore third-party integrations for extended capabilities like IFTTT or SmartThings.
